description: A webhook-verification-policy artifact defines how incoming webhook payloads are cryptographically verified, preventing spoofed events and replay attacks.

rules.description: Policy must declare at least one webhook with provider and signing_algorithm.
Every webhook must declare constant_time_comparison: true to prevent timing-based HMAC key extraction.
replay_protection_window_seconds must be declared and must not exceed 300 seconds.
signature_required must not be false and signature_optional must not be true.
signing_algorithm must be one of: hmac-sha256, hmac-sha512, rsa-sha256, ed25519.
secret_ref must reference a key in the secret-handling-policy — the signing secret must never be hardcoded in the policy.
